extensionAttribute.description: Returns the date of the most recent ClamXav virus definitions update.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # ClamXav Virus Definition Date Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe) # Modern ClamXav (v3+) ships its engine inside the .app bundle. We check # the bundle path first, then the legacy /usr/local/clamXav install.
for fc in \ "/Applications/ClamXAV.app/Contents/Resources/ScanningEngine/bin/freshclam" \ "/usr/local/clamXav/bin/freshclam" do [[ -x "$fc" ]] && freshclam="$fc" && break done
if [[ -z "$freshclam" ]]; then echo "<result>Not installed</result>" exit 0 fi
raw=$("$freshclam" --version 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk -F'/' '{print $3}') if [[ -n "$raw" ]]; then iso=$(/bin/date -j -f "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y" "$raw" "+%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00" 2>/dev/null) fi
echo "<result>${iso:-Unknown}</result>"
